summary: Computes a 3D position delta and stores it in this+0xC/0x10/0x14. When the pointer at this+0x110 is non-null, delta = *(this+0x110) minus the inline triple at this+0/0x4/0x8. Otherwise, when the pointer at this+0x10C is non-null, delta = inline triple at this+0/0x4/0x8 minus *(this+0x10C). When both pointers are null it writes the default delta (0, 0, -1.0f).

operations.description: Load the pointer at this+0x110; if non-null take the forward-delta branch.
Compute deltaX = *(this+0x110) x - this+0 x and store it in this+0xC.
Compute deltaY = *(this+0x110) y - this+0x4 y and store it in this+0x10.
Compute deltaZ = *(this+0x110) z - this+0x8 z and store it in this+0x14.
When this+0x110 is null, load the pointer at this+0x10C; if non-null take the reverse-delta branch.
Compute deltaX = this+0 x - *(this+0x10C) x and store it in this+0xC.
Compute deltaY = this+0x4 y - *(this+0x10C) y and store it in this+0x10.
Compute deltaZ = this+0x8 z - *(this+0x10C) z and store it in this+0x14.
Fallback when both pointers are null: write 0 to this+0xC and this+0x10 and -1082130432 (-1.0f) to this+0x14.
Return the leftover register value from whichever branch executed.
